name: DJCockpit – Anfrageformular mit Terminprüfung
author: DJCockpit

sections.description:
Deutsch: Mit diesem Plugin fragen Brautpaare und Gäste direkt auf deiner Website bei dir an – ohne deine Seite zu verlassen.

Das Anfrageformular öffnet sich als Fenster über deiner Website. Gleich am Anfang sehen deine Besucher an einer Ampel, ob ihr Wunschtermin noch frei, schon angefragt oder vergeben ist. Passt der Termin, schicken sie ihre Anfrage ab – und die landet sofort in deinem DJCockpit.

So richtest du es ein: Plugin installieren, unter Einstellungen → DJCockpit deinen DJCockpit-Namen eintragen und auf „Speichern und prüfen“ klicken. Deinen Namen findest du in deiner Adresse: Bei dj-max.djcockpit.de ist es dj-max. Ab dann öffnet jeder Link auf deine Anfrageseite automatisch das Fenster.

Lieber direkt auf einer Seite? Setz dort [djcockpit] ein. Dann erscheint an dieser Stelle ein Knopf „Termin prüfen“, und das Formular öffnet sich genau dort.

Du brauchst ein DJCockpit-Konto – den kostenlosen Tarif gibt es dauerhaft.

Anleitung Schritt für Schritt, mit Bildern: djcockpit.de/wordpress-plugin

English: This plugin connects your WordPress site with DJCockpit, a booking and business software for DJs. Enter your DJCockpit subdomain in the settings, and every link to your DJCockpit inquiry page opens the inquiry form in a window on top of your site, including a live availability check. Use [djcockpit] to show the form inline on a page.

What you need

  • A DJCockpit account. The free plan costs nothing, permanently: create one.
  • Without a subdomain entered, the plugin outputs nothing on your site.

Appearance

Colors, light or dark background and the form’s tone (ihr, du or Sie) are set in DJCockpit (Settings → Profile → “Deine Anfrageseite”). Changes show up on your site within a minute. The form is shielded from your theme’s styles, so page builders and optimization plugins don’t change it.

External services

This plugin connects to DJCockpit (https://djcockpit.de), the service that receives and manages your booking inquiries.

  • When a visitor clicks a link to your DJCockpit inquiry page or the [djcockpit] button, the visitor’s browser loads the form script from https://djcockpit.de/einbinden.js and your form settings from https://djcockpit.de/api/einbinden/<your-subdomain>. This transmits the visitor’s IP address to DJCockpit. Nothing is loaded from DJCockpit before that click.
  • When the visitor checks a date, the date and your subdomain are sent to https://djcockpit.de/api/verfuegbarkeit to show availability.
  • When the visitor submits the form, the entered data (date, occasion, location, salutation, name, email, phone, message, optional consent to forward the inquiry to a colleague) and the page address are sent to https://djcockpit.de/api/anfrage and stored in your DJCockpit account.
  • When you save the plugin settings, your WordPress site asks https://djcockpit.de/api/einbinden/<your-subdomain> whether the subdomain exists.

DJCockpit processes this data on your behalf (data processing agreement included in DJCockpit). Terms of use: https://djcockpit.de/agb · Privacy policy: https://djcockpit.de/datenschutz · Data processing agreement: https://djcockpit.de/avv

Please add a sentence about this to your own privacy policy — DJCockpit offers a ready-made text in its settings.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Go to Settings → DJCockpit and enter your subdomain (for dj-max.djcockpit.de enter dj-max). Click “Speichern und prüfen”.
  3. Done. Every link to your inquiry page now opens the form as a window. Optional: place [djcockpit] on a page.
  4. If you use a caching plugin (e.g. WP Rocket), clear the cache once.

Step-by-step guide with screenshots (German): https://djcockpit.de/wordpress-plugin
sections.faq:
Does this work with WP Rocket, LiteSpeed Cache or Cloudflare?

Yes. The small loader is excluded from “delay JavaScript” features of WP Rocket, LiteSpeed and Cloudflare Rocket Loader, so the first click on your site already opens the form.

What happens without JavaScript, or if DJCockpit cannot be reached?

The links stay normal links to your DJCockpit inquiry page. Nobody gets stuck.

Can I use it without DJCockpit?

No. The plugin only connects your site with your DJCockpit account. Without a subdomain it does nothing.

Does the plugin set cookies or track visitors?

No. The plugin sets no cookies and loads nothing before a visitor clicks.
